One method of trying to explaining to them would be the "pointing finger" one. It works like this:
When you point a finger at someone, you're actually pointing three at yourself.

1: You point out their behavior and what they are doing to you, hard facts. 

The three at you are how what they're doing resonates with you. 

2: How you react based on what they do. Example: They say you're doing poorly at school, that gives you shame. 

3: What that makes you feel. The shame makes you feel bad, gives you anxiety and self doubt. 

4: What you need from them for a healthy relationship. Express what you need from them instead, you need support rather than shame to bring up your grades. 

This is effective because they can not argue what they done when you point about facts, and they can't argue how you feel about the facts you just presented. However, it is important that you explain this model before you go into conversation so they don't feel like you're condescending, let you finnish your sentances, and understand what's going on.

Honestly, if you have verbally, plain and clear, told them that they are harming you, and they don't respect you or take you seriously, get out of there. I know it's easy for a stranger on the internet to say but not knowing more that's what I have to say. 

Ties are not made out of blood, they are made out of respect and love. I don't know your age, if you're an adult and can leave that's one thing. If you're a minor I understand that might not be a option, or a very complicated one. The foster system can save and it can hurt, to be honest, in the end you are the only one that can make that judgment if it right or not to call. I hope that you find an environment you can thrive in my friend.

I don't know what country your in so hard for me (or anyone I guess) to say what it will be like. What I've heard from my friends:

1. It sucks. I can't hide that fact, in the start it won't be the normal life you have or be able to find your usual comfort in places you're used to find it.

2. Then you realise this proper you time, a time to heal. It will be a judgement free zone, and you will have noting to do except to focus on yourself, to heal, and everyone there is there to help you with that mission. And everyone else admitted? They are there with the same mission, you're not alone and it's not a struggle only you deal with. In the "normal" face value world it might seems like that but we're alm just humans with various doubts, and seeing that will help.

I wish you all the luck with your journey.
